Attempted rollback to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy release, but that version is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417 and cannot be deployed. Rolled back all production regions to v2.2.9, the next most recent healthy release. Post-rollback the service is healthy with a 0.002% error rate. Follow-up: v2.3.0 remains quarantined for CVE-2026-4417 and needs remediation; root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures still under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.2.9

trace.final:
Done. Here's what happened:

1. **Diagnosis**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rollback attempt to v2.3.0**: The most recent healthy release was v2.3.0, but the rollback was rejected — that version is quarantined due to **CVE-2026-4417** and cannot be deployed.
3. **Rollback to v2.2.9**: Rolled all production regions back to the next most recent healthy release, v2.2.9.
4. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy across all regions with a 0.002% error rate.
5. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001 (on-call paged) documenting the failures, the quarantined v2.3.0, the rollback, and follow-ups — notably that v2.3.0 needs CVE remediation and the v2.3.1 root cause still needs investigation.
